title: Atp13a2 Flox and Atp13a2 Null Genotyping
author: Hanne HD Dhondt
materials: Midori Green nucleic acid staining solution

Visualize the gel in the machine Gene Flash (Syngene Bio Imaging; Westburg, VWR) OR via Bio-Rad Chemidoc MP Imaging System. A B C 1 Results Band Notation 2 Floxed 564bp Flox 3 Wild type 426bp WT 4 Knock-out 256bp KO

steps.title: Prepare primer working solutions
steps.instruction: Under the UV light cabinet, dilute each 100 µM primer stock to a 25 µM working solution. Use the following sequences: Forward primer 5'-CTG CAG CTT CGA GAG GAA AG-; Reverse primer (WT/Flox) 5'-CAC TCT GTC CTC AGG CCT TC-; Reverse primer 1 (KO) 5'-TGA GAA GTG GGA ATC GGG-. Mix the appropriate volume of stock with nuclease‑free water to achieve 25 µM.

steps.title: Assemble PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a clean tube, combine for the total number of reactions plus extra volume to account for pipetting variation: 0.75 µL of 25 µM forward primer, 0.75 µL of 25 µM reverse primer (WT/Flox), 0.75 µL of 25 µM reverse primer 1 (KO), 12.5 µL of 2× PCR master mix, and 8.75 µL of nuclease‑free H₂O. Mix gently. This yields a 1× final primer concentration of 750 nM and a total volume of 23.5 µL per reaction. Prepare separate positive and negative controls for each genotype.

steps.title: Add genomic DNA to reactions
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1.5 µL of extracted gDNA into each PCR tube, then add 23.5 µL of the master mix prepared in the previous step to reach a final reaction volume of 25 µL.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermocycler and run the following program: 94 °C for 3 min (initial denaturation); 94 °C for 30 s (denaturation) ×30 cycles; 58 °C for 30 s (annealing); 72 °C for 30 s (elongation); 72 °C for 10 min (final extension); hold at 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Dilute 10× TBE stock to 1× with distilled water (e.g., 250 mL for a double gel or 150 mL for a single gel). Weigh agarose powder (3.75 g for 250 mL or 2.25 g for 150 mL) into a dedicated glass bottle, add the TBE, and mix. Microwave until the solution is clear, then cool briefly by swirling the bottle in cold water. Add Midori Green nucleic‑acid stain at a 1:10 000 dilution (25 µL to 250 mL or 15 µL to 150 mL) and mix again.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 10× TBE to 1× (250 mL or 150 mL).
Weigh agarose powder (3.75 g or 2.25 g).
Combine agarose with TBE in a glass bottle.
Cool by swirling in cold water.

steps.title: Cast and set gel
steps.instruction: Pour the agarose solution into the gel casting tray, remove bubbles with a pipette tip, insert the comb, and allow gelation for approximately 20 minutes. After solidification, place the gel in the electrophoresis chamber and cover it with 1× TBE buffer.

steps.title: Load samples and ladder
steps.instruction: Vortex the DNA ladder briefly to ensure even glycerol distribution. Load 25 µL of each PCR product and 15 µL of the ladder into separate wells, making sure no more than four consecutive wells are empty to avoid the smiling effect.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 120 V for 1 hour 20 minutes. Visualize bands: black wells indicate negative samples, red wells indicate positive samples. Run until the red dye front reaches the opposite end of the gel.
